resources.string: Measures this car’s screen halves, video decoder, Wi-Fi, USB, audio and keys so DiPlay can be tuned for the Mazda EZ-60. Nothing is sent automatically.

Recording. Now swipe DiPlay to the other half of the screen and back, wake the voice assistant, press each steering-wheel button, switch between day and night and plug in the iPhone. Then stop recording and run the probe.
On an iPhone on the same Wi-Fi as the car (the car hotspot or the iPhone’s hotspot), open in Safari:\n%1$s
The car is not on any Wi-Fi network. Turn on the car hotspot or join the iPhone’s hotspot, then try again.
